limitations: Each screenshot is zoomed to its own selected Host scope; picture widths are not a speedup comparison.
Operator DCP1 trace has flow warnings; DCP2 trace has flow and slice-overlap warnings; some Host-to-device deltas are negative.
Full PCP rank0 JSON import reports 1044 slice_spill_overlapping_complete_event: overlapping complete events rendered on overflow tracks; not treated as discarded compute.
No calibrated cross-rank timeline, dispatch-latency measurement, NPU internal pipeline reconstruction or throughput conclusion.
PCP screenshot is one actual Attention scope in a chunked/mixed model capture, not an entire 513-token request.
Raw traces and original environment logs are private; only selected viewer screenshots and sanitized results are published.
Both ranks were captured in each corresponding original two-rank run. Per-rank export origins differ; first-event zero is not a shared iteration-start anchor.
Host conversion metadata on the same host is close, as retained in rank-comparison.json; this is not a measured Host/device or cross-device alignment error bound.
Rank1 DCP1 import: flow_no_enclosing_slice=2, overlapping_complete_event=1; DCP2: flow=50, overlap=14. Rank1 full PCP: overlap=916.
PCP scope9 has CPU FIA calls on both ranks. Rank1 lacks an associated Device FIA/flow observation; this does not identify empty queries, skipped execution, dropped samples or failure.
